patch.value: Stop predeclared evaluations safely at sequential boundaries

Extend sealed evaluation plans with reviewed sequential stopping. Acceptance: deterministic null and benefit simulations validate the declared error bound; seal the rule before collection; fixed plans preserve behavior; saved checkpoints resume without recounting. Include typed SDK and CLI, compact reports, typed remedies, model-based replay tests, boundary interleavings and read-only public tracker evidence.

value.author: codex-agent
value.text: Overlap check on current CLI 2026.10.25 and sibling package source/docs: pm-rl-evalplans explicitly seals fixed stopping; core SDK exposes tracker transactions and locks, not sequential statistics; pm-jev owns inference receipts, pm-context context selection, pm-rlm inference recursion. No existing alpha-spending evaluation protocol found. This extends pm-rl evaluation plans, retaining promotion approval and contamination gates. Design: predeclared finite looks over frozen complete correlation units, two-sided Hoeffding alpha spending, reviewed rule identity, immutable append-only checkpoint chain with SDK writer serialization and current provenance checks on every retry. No import/export/sync subsystem or status-name classification is introduced.

value.text: Additional concurrency hardening found during final audit: hold native SDK locks on every predecessor checkpoint through dependent checkpoint publication, so an ordinary SDK writer cannot change a predecessor into a foreign record after validation. This prevents a dependent write before returning a skip. A new real-peer test injects the mutation immediately before and after publication, then verifies foreign state is observed after lease release. Superseding the prior code-head CI run; only the eventual complete final-head run will count as gate evidence.
